settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.intro: Every WRYDECO piece is handcrafted from solid natural wood, shaped by skilled artisans into furniture that reflects natural form, careful handwork, and lasting character.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer:
For most standard orders delivered worldwide, the total estimated time from order placement to delivery is approximately 18–25 business days.

This generally includes approximately 15–20 business days for processing, preparation, production coordination, quality checks, packaging, and fulfillment, followed by approximately 3–5 business days in transit after shipment.

These timeframes are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates. Custom, made-to-order, oversized, personalized, or specially handled pieces may require additional time.

settings.question: Why does production take as long as it does?
settings.answer: Because your piece does not exist yet when you order it. Processing covers material selection, production coordination, hand shaping and joinery, finishing, quality checks, and protective packing. The clock starts once your payment is authorised and any customization details or approvals have been confirmed. Before packing, we send final photos or video for your confirmation, so replying quickly to our questions and approvals is the single best way to keep your timeline short.

settings.question: Is shipping included, and who delivers it?
settings.answer:
Yes. Complimentary standard shipping is included with WRYDECO orders accepted for delivery to eligible addresses worldwide, with no minimum order value required.

Complimentary shipping applies to the standard delivery method selected by WRYDECO and our logistics partners. Optional expedited, specialized, installation, storage, redelivery, or other additional services may be subject to separate charges if available.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You will receive an order confirmation by email as soon as your order is placed, and a shipping confirmation with tracking details once the piece leaves us — tracking can take some time to become active on the carrier side. If your confirmation has not arrived, check the spam folder first, then write to support@wrydeco.com with your order number.

settings.question: Can you deliver worldwide?
settings.answer:
Yes. WRYDECO accepts online orders for delivery to eligible addresses worldwide.

International orders may be placed through checkout where available. Delivery availability may depend on the destination, accessibility of the delivery address, product dimensions, carrier coverage, and other logistical requirements.

Complimentary standard shipping is included on eligible international and domestic orders.

settings.question: When am I charged, and is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Payment is taken at checkout. The transaction is handled by Shopify secure payment infrastructure, so your card details are never visible to or stored by us. Processing of your order begins once payment has been authorised or completed and all required shipping, contact, and specification details are in place.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer:
Cancellation requests may be considered only before production, preparation, or fulfillment has begun.

Please contact WRYDECO as soon as possible with your order number if you wish to request a cancellation. Cancellation cannot be guaranteed after an order has been placed.

Once production, preparation, or fulfillment has begun, custom and made-to-order orders generally cannot be cancelled, changed, returned, or refunded, except where required by applicable law or where an approved damage, defect, or fulfillment issue applies.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange a piece?
settings.answer:
WRYDECO does not accept returns, exchanges, or refunds for customer-related reasons such as change of mind, personal preference, incorrect product selection, dimensions, finish, style choice, or because an item does not fit the customer’s space.

Custom, personalized, made-to-order, and special-order pieces are generally non-returnable for customer-related reasons.

However, if an item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect due to a fulfillment error, the issue may be reviewed under our Return & Refund Policy if reported within 30 calendar days of delivery. Depending on the circumstances, an approved claim may result in a return, repair, replacement part, replacement item, partial refund, or full refund.

settings.question: My piece arrived damaged or incorrect. What should I do?
settings.answer:
If your item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect due to a fulfillment error, please contact WRYDECO within 30 calendar days of delivery.

Please provide:

  • Your full name and order number
  • A clear description of the issue
  • Clear photos of the product
  • Photos of the outer and inner packaging
  • Photos of the shipping label
  • Video evidence where the issue is best demonstrated by video

Please preserve the item and all original packaging while your claim is being reviewed. Do not return, repair, alter, install, modify, or discard the item or packaging unless WRYDECO provides written instructions.

settings.question: Can I order a piece in a custom size?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. On the product page, choose the Custom option under size and describe the dimensions you need. That submits a request to our team rather than an order, so nothing is charged while we assess feasibility, lead time, and price. For a piece designed from scratch rather than resized, start with a consultation instead.

settings.question: Can I request a wood finish that is not listed?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. On the product page, choose the Custom option under size and describe the dimensions you need. That submits a request to our team rather than an order, so nothing is charged while we assess feasibility, lead time, and price. Our team responds during business hours. Response times may vary depending on weekends, public holidays, request complexity, and message volume. For a piece designed from scratch rather than resized, start with a consultation instead.

settings.question: What wood is used, and will my piece match the photographs?
settings.answer: Solid natural wood, selected for grain, form, and structural suitability for each design. The material and finish specified for your piece are stated on its product page or in your proposal. The design and proportions will match the photographs; the wood itself will not. Grain, tone, knots, texture, and organic edges vary from board to board, and those differences are the character of the work rather than a fault in it.

settings.question: How do I care for my piece, and can it be restored later?
settings.answer: Dust with a soft dry cloth, wipe spills promptly, and avoid abrasive pads, harsh chemicals, standing moisture, sustained direct sunlight, heating vents, and sharp humidity swings. Your delivered piece includes product-specific use, placement, mounting, hardware, and recommended load guidance where applicable. Solid wood can usually be maintained or professionally restored years later. Send us photographs before applying any oil, wax, filler, or stripper so we can advise based on the original finish.

settings.question: Can I speak to someone before I buy, and do you work with designers?
settings.answer:
Yes to both. A private consultation is complimentary before you order and carries no obligation to purchase. Share your product, room details, rough dimensions, finish direction, timeline, budget range, or references. Messages may be submitted 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Customer support responses are provided during business hours. Response times may vary depending on weekends, public holidays, request complexity, message volume, seasonal demand, and other operational factors.

We also work with interior designers and studios on specifications, custom sizing, finish matching, and project timelines for residential and boutique commercial work.

settings.question: Who actually makes these pieces?
settings.answer: WRYDECO is a US-operated furniture brand. Our pieces are handcrafted by skilled artisans in Vietnam, where shaping, joinery, finishing, and inspection are carried out by people rather than a production line. Our online support team coordinates questions, custom details, production updates, and delivery support.

settings.question: How does a full bespoke commission work?
settings.answer: It starts with a complimentary consultation: your room, rough dimensions, the product type you have in mind, budget range, timeline, and any references. We review the request, contact you by email, phone, or WhatsApp when needed, then define the scope, detailed specification, and quote. Once every detail feels right, we send a secure payment link for your order. After payment and final approval, our artisans begin crafting your piece, followed by proof review and final photos or video before packing.

settings.question: What if I experience an issue with my WRYDECO piece?
settings.answer:
If you experience an issue with your WRYDECO piece, please contact our customer support team with your order number and a clear description of the issue.

For items that arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect due to a fulfillment error, claims should be submitted within 30 calendar days of delivery and will be reviewed under our Return & Refund Policy.

For other product or after-sales questions, our team will review the circumstances and advise you on the available next steps.
